title: Career Roadmap · Smart Agri Technician
summary: A Smart Agriculture Technician installs, operates and maintains technology used in modern farming, including soil-moisture sensors, automated irrigation, weather stations, farm-monitoring systems, drones and connected agricultural equipment.

facts.Current degree: ITI Smart Agriculture Technician / Agricultural Electronics / Precision Agriculture

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Agriculture basics, electrical safety, sensors, soil moisture and irrigation systems.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Technical skills
blocks.text: Install and test sensors, controllers, pumps, automated irrigation and weather-monitoring equipment.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced practice
blocks.text: Data logging, connectivity troubleshooting, system calibration and preventive maintenance.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Complete supervised field projects, document system performance and practise customer training.

blocks.text: Soil-moisture monitoring system • Automated irrigation prototype • Farm weather-data dashboard • Sensor maintenance checklist.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Recognized academic qualifications, mathematics or science prerequisites for some technical programs, language proficiency where required, and program-specific tests or experience. Verify current admissions on official university websites.
